digest.component_or_area: pytest fixture teardown for snapshot tests
propositions: macOS pytest basetemp cleanup fails with PermissionError after snapshot tests because read-only .rebar/run_snapshots trees survive teardown
snapshot production intentionally applies 0444/0555 permissions via _chmod_readonly, but cleanup was owned only by module-local fixture in test_snapshot.py
snapshot producers in other test modules leave non-removable .rebar/run_snapshots/<sha> entries below pytest basetemp
centralized shared teardown in conftest.py now searches and removes exact .rebar/run_snapshots roots below each tmp_path using snapshot._rmtree_writable
production snapshot permissions and read-only test assertions remain unchanged after moving cleanup responsibility to shared fixture
adjacent temporary files outside .rebar/run_snapshots are preserved during shared teardown
